test.create_query: CREATE TABLE merge_src_1p ( WatchID UInt64, JavaEnable UInt8, Title String, GoodEvent Int16, EventTime DateTime, EventDate Date, CounterID UInt32, ClientIP UInt32, RegionID UInt32, UserID UInt64, OS UInt8, UserAgent UInt8, URL String, Referer String, ResolutionWidth UInt16, ResolutionHeight UInt16, IsMobile UInt8, MobilePhoneModel String, SearchEngineID UInt16, SearchPhrase String, AdvEngineID UInt8, WindowClientWidth UInt16, WindowClientHeight UInt16, Refresh UInt8, PageCharset String, CodeVersion UInt32, FUniqID UInt64, OriginalURL String, HID UInt32, ParamOrderID String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID), EventTime) SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 10
CREATE TABLE merge_src_16p AS merge_src_1p ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY intHash32(UserID) % 16 ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID), EventTime) SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 10

CREATE TABLE merge_1p AS merge_src_1p ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID), EventTime) SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 10, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1

CREATE TABLE merge_16p AS merge_src_1p ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY intHash32(UserID) % 16 ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID), EventTime) SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 10, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO merge_src_1p SELECT WatchID, JavaEnable, Title, GoodEvent, EventTime, EventDate, CounterID, ClientIP, RegionID, UserID, OS, UserAgent, URL, Referer, ResolutionWidth, ResolutionHeight, IsMobile, MobilePhoneModel, SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase, AdvEngineID, WindowClientWidth, WindowClientHeight, Refresh, PageCharset, CodeVersion, FUniqID, OriginalURL, HID, ParamOrderID FROM hits_100m_single WHERE intHash64(WatchID) % 10 < 2 LIMIT 10000000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 100000, max_insert_block_size = 100000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 100000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO merge_src_16p SELECT WatchID, JavaEnable, Title, GoodEvent, EventTime, EventDate, CounterID, ClientIP, RegionID, UserID, OS, UserAgent, URL, Referer, ResolutionWidth, ResolutionHeight, IsMobile, MobilePhoneModel, SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase, AdvEngineID, WindowClientWidth, WindowClientHeight, Refresh, PageCharset, CodeVersion, FUniqID, OriginalURL, HID, ParamOrderID FROM hits_100m_single WHERE intHash64(WatchID) % 10 BETWEEN 2 AND 6 LIMIT 10000000 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 250000, max_insert_block_size = 250000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 250000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, max_partitions_per_insert_block = 0
SELECT throwIf(count() != 100) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'merge_src_1p' AND active
SELECT throwIf(count() != 640) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'merge_src_16p' AND active
ALTER TABLE merge_1p ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM merge_src_1p
SELECT throwIf(count() != 100 OR sum(rows) != 10000000) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'merge_1p' AND active
OPTIMIZE TABLE merge_1p FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
SELECT throwIf(count() != 1 OR sum(rows) != 10000000) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'merge_1p' AND active
SELECT throwIf((SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) FROM merge_1p) != (SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) FROM merge_src_1p))
ALTER TABLE merge_16p ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM merge_src_16p
SELECT throwIf(count() != 640 OR sum(rows) != 10000000) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'merge_16p' AND active
OPTIMIZE TABLE merge_16p FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
SELECT throwIf(count() != 16 OR sum(rows) != 10000000) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'merge_16p' AND active
SELECT throwIf((SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) FROM merge_16p) != (SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) FROM merge_src_16p))
test.query: ${CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT} --query "TRUNCATE TABLE merge_1p; ALTER TABLE merge_1p ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM merge_src_1p; OPTIMIZE TABLE merge_1p FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1"
${CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT} --query "TRUNCATE TABLE merge_16p; ALTER TABLE merge_16p ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM merge_src_16p; OPTIMIZE TABLE merge_16p FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1"
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS merge_1p, merge_16p, merge_src_1p, merge_src_16p SYNC
